evidence_class: EXTERNAL CI INTEROPERABILITY POINTER WITH RECIPROCAL FINDING
interpretation_boundary: The run proves one exact external wire crossing from dtn7-go to bp7-rs through the GatewayCX authentication, fault and ledger path.
The pinned reciprocal bp7-rs wire image self-decodes but dtn7-go rejects it with EOF; this is a recorded interoperability finding, not bidirectional conformance.
Neither full routing daemon, a convergence-layer session, BPSec, contact routing nor remote application completion is exercised.
